basic_info.description: Now transparent price! (Isn't that nice?) First - the fine print (because we believe in transparency): the property is missing its final permit and has a few open Notices of Violation and abatements. Bring your architect and/or contractor to understand the final vision. For the right buyer, it's a dream project that's part of the way there. And here's the kicker: for qualified buyers, ask about a special low interest rate! This isn't a fixer. It's a finisher! 464 Hoffman is a fully reimagined Noe Valley home waiting for someone to bring it across the finish line. The home has been extensively transformed with new electrical in 2024, plumbing, and HVAC systems, a reinforced foundation w/steel beams, all-new siding, and a 2019 roof.The open-concept great room flows to the backyard through afour-panelaccordion door for effortless indoor-outdoor living. The kitchen has custom wood cabinetry, Caesarstone waterfall counters, a Thermador stove, and a Fischer & Paykel fridge. Upstairs, you'll find all three bedrooms, including a primary suite w/ private deck and an upstairs laundry room where it actually belongs. The terraced yard feels like its own little park, anchored by a mature oak tree, complete with a gas line for your grill or firepit and a bonus detached shed.
